en-US.author: Micah Kepe
en-US.description: JSONPath-inspired query language for JSON, YAML, TOML, and other serialization formats
en-US.longDescription:
jsongrep is a command-line tool providing a JSONPath-inspired query language
for searching and filtering JSON, YAML, TOML, CBOR, and MessagePack data.
It supports wildcards, recursive descent, array slicing, filter expressions,
and regex matching.
en-US.name: jsongrep
en-US.releaseNotes:
Release 0.10.0 of jsongrep
What's Changed
- chore(deps): drop unused regex, log, env_logger, clap-verbosity-flag by @vlasky in #40
- chore(tests): delete tests/lib.rs so the CLI suite runs once, not twice by @vlasky in #47
- fix(parser): reject /regex/ queries cleanly; make [usize::MAX] well-defined by @vlasky in #41
- fix(cli): read input as bytes; fall back from mmap for non-regular files by @vlasky in #42
- fix(dfa): cap state count during determinization (bounded compilation) by @vlasky in #43
- fix(cli): make --porcelain honest - force colors off, imply --compact by @vlasky in #48
- feat(cli): -r/--raw-output prints matched strings unquoted (jq -r) by @vlasky in #44
- ci: test on macOS/Windows, add MSRV job, cache, full-target clippy, doc gate by @vlasky in #56
- ci(release): gate cargo publish on tests and binary builds; pin actions by SHA by @vlasky in #57
- fix(ast): keep '.' separator where omitting it changes query meaning by @vlasky in #53
- perf(output): skip unused path strings and stop formatting on broken pipe by @vlasky in #38
- perf(dfa): eliminate per-key allocations on the document-walk hot path by @vlasky in #35
- feat(cli): -e/--exit-status and -q/--quiet with grep exit codes by @vlasky in #45
- perf(cli): parse JSONL per line instead of building a synthetic array string by @vlasky in #37
- fix(grammar): accept chained array accesses like foo[0][1] by @vlasky in #52
- fix(parser): decode UTF-16 surrogate pairs in quoted fields by @vlasky in #51
- feat(cli): multiple file arguments, file headings, -l/--files-with-matches by @vlasky in #49
- fix(ast): parenthesize modified display operands that need it by @vlasky in #54
- perf(dfa): rework subset construction around bitsets and a label-symbol table by @vlasky in #36
- fix(ast): elide empty subqueries in sequence display by @vlasky in #58
- perf(dfa): visitor-based traversal with early exit, find_limited, -m/--max-count by @vlasky in #39
- test: add property-based suite for parse, DFA build, and display by @vlasky in #59
- feat(cli): --glob + --files options by @micahkepe in #60

New Contributors
- @vlasky made their first contribution in #40
